source: Example numbers for a made-up six-week fitness challenge business. Every figure is invented for the walkthrough; none belongs to a real business.
confidenceNote: Illustrative only. Money is integer cents.
note: Loaded by 'Try with example numbers'. It fills every fact, quiz, choice and checklist, so every recipe lights and every chart draws.

facts.promise: Lose the first ten pounds in six weeks
facts.attrOffer: Lose ten pounds in six weeks for $500, and win it all back if you finish every session.
facts.attrString: The week-two results check-in with a coach
facts.upScript: Since you want the ten pounds gone for good, the people who keep it off go straight onto the year programme, and the $500 you paid comes off it. Want me to set that up?
facts.upNoReply: Totally fair. Would three payments make it work?
facts.downScript: No problem. We can do the same programme as three payments of $150; you still get the full year.
facts.downCut: Nothing is cut; the terms are longer
facts.contScript: To keep the weight off, most people stay on as members: $149 a month, and if you start today the first month's meal plans are included.
facts.contHook: A new eight-week block every two months, and a tracked weigh-in chart
facts.scoreboardWhere: The whiteboard by the front desk
